text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Iraqi official press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The Revolutionary Command Council issues a decision creating a new office called the civil reserve office which admits government director generals who have spent more than seven years in service.
- Qatari foreign minister receives Iraqi ambassador in Qatar.
- National Assembly speaker Saadoun Hammadi starts visit to Russia.
- Iraq to be represented in an environmental meeting in Amman.
- Editorial lashing out at the Turkish decision to extend the mandate of the U.S.-led force patrolling northern Iraq.
- Commentary praises the return of Hong Kong to China.
(The above except the editorial and the commentary were carried by QADISSIYA and JUMHOURIYA)
